title: Countdown of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: From the depths of the temporal rift came Chen Tianming's aged and urgent voice: "Ji'er, the time is at hand, I need you to do one final thing."

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure solidified from the void like a specter, and all the candles in the Tianqing Sect Council Hall extinguished in that instant. The old man's aura was deep as an abyss, every step causing the spiritual pressure within the hall to surge by another threefold. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his aged face betraying no emotion, yet in those murky pupils lurked a trace of barely perceptible greed. "I have waited three whole months for you to appear." Ling Yuan's voice was terrifyingly calm. "The successor of Chen Xuan, you truly haven't disappointed this old man." Chen Ji stood in place, his face still wearing that cowardly waste of a disciple appearance, but hidden within his sleeves his hands were already silently forming seals. He knew that any panic at this moment would only expose him further.

dialogue.content: "You're too kind, Senior." Chen Ji slightly bowed, his voice carrying just the right amount of trembling. "This disciple is merely trash from the Servants' Quarters, how could I possibly deserve such attention from the Senior?" Ling Yuan sneered, his withered finger pointing at Chen Ji's brow center: "Trash? One who could escape unscathed from the encirclement and suppression of three major sects, one who could obtain the Tianji Record Fragment from the Ancient Forbidden Land—your 'trash' has truly broadened this old man's horizons."

text.content: Just as Ling Yuan's fingertip was about to touch Chen Ji's brow center, the Tianji Record Fragment within Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly scorched hot. Mo Xiansheng's aged and urgent voice came: "The price of wielding the Tianji Record is beyond your current bearing, but this old man can lend you a trace of remnant soul power—remember, only three breaths!" Chen Ji felt the surrounding pressure suddenly release, the spiritual pressure from the old sect master blocked by an invisible force. Seizing this opening, he abruptly retreated three steps, his cowardly expression gone, replaced by a hint of serene smile.

dialogue.content: "Senior Ling Yuan." For the first time, Chen Ji addressed him directly by name, his tone as calm as if narrating something inconsequential. "You've been tracking the aura of the Tianji Record for thirty years. When Chen Xuan's master chose my grandfather over you, did any resentment exist in your heart?" Ling Yuan's pupils abruptly contracted, and finally a crack appeared on that aged face. Thirty years—this was the scar he least wanted mentioned.

"Presumptuous!" Ling Yuan roared, spiritual energy surging around him like a tide. "You dare speak of Chen Xuan to this old man? Do you think a Foundation Building trash like you is qualified? The Tianji Record has chosen wrongly. Today this old man shall cleanse the sect for Heavenly Dao!" Before his words even finished, a giant palm that blotted out the sky came crashing down upon Chen Ji's head. However, at this critical moment, Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand, a cryptic rune appearing in his palm—the protective divine ability that Mo Xiansheng taught him when the first page of the Tianji Record was unsealed.

text.content: The rune collided with the giant palm, producing a deafening roar. Ling Yuan's assault was forcibly halted for an instant, and in that instant, Chen Ji's form surged backward as a golden light flew from his sleeve—the Suppression Immortal Rope he had obtained in the Ancient Forbidden Land. This rope was originally a trump card for dealing with demonic path experts, yet now he毫不犹豫地 hurled it at Ling Yuan without hesitation. Ling Yuan coldly snorted, flicking it away with one finger, but in that brief delay, Chen Ji had already retreated into the depths of the back hall. "Until we meet again." Chen Ji's voice came from the darkness, carrying an enigmatic smile.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fled the Council Hall, stopping at a secluded cliff. The Tianji Record Fragment appeared on its own in his palm as Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly rose, his expression grave: "You've revealed too much today. Ling Yuan will not let this rest, and the forces behind him will grow vigilant." Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then asked: "Master, did you sense anything of my sister's whereabouts?" Mo Xiansheng sighed: "This old man sensed the aura of that Heavenly Fate Lock Key—she is indeed still alive, deep within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. But the seal there cannot be breached without Heavenly Dao-level power."

text.content: Chen Ji tightly gripped the Tianji Record, his knuckles whitening from the force. Chen Nian—his sister, missing for many years, the girl taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Her existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight; any vision with her in it was blurry. This was his greatest vulnerability, the reason he must rescue her. "There is one more thing." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became solemn. "This old man just sensed a familiar aura from the depths of the temporal rift—Chen Tianming's remnant soul is calling to you."

dialogue.content: "Grandfather?" Chen Ji lifted his head sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment began to vibrate intensely, Mo Xiansheng's expression becoming unprecedentedly serious: "Chen Tianming once used himself as bait to fall into the temporal rift in order to seal the Heavenly Eye. His remnant soul has been trapped there all along, waiting for an opportunity. And now—" Mo Xiansheng paused. "In the seventy percent of the Tianji Record's content that is fully unsealed, this old man has finally found a method to potentially recall him. But this requires you to make a choice." The pages of the Tianji Record began to turn on their own, revealing two passages of blurred text.

text.content: Path One: Break the Chains. Using Chen Tianming's remnant soul as a medium, completely destroy the Heavenly Eye's control over destiny. All bound prophets will gain freedom, including you. But the price—your Tianji Record will be destroyed alongside you. Path Two: Replace Heaven. Devour Chen Tianming's remnant soul, inherit his unfinished will, become the new Heavenly Eye. You will possess the power to rewrite fate, but the price—you will forever lose your qualification as a human, becoming an existence beyond everything. Two paths, two fates, like the two ends of a scale,静静地 awaiting Chen Ji's choice.

choice.prompt: The two paths lie before Chen Ji, and he must make a decision. He knows that no matter which path he chooses, it will completely change his destiny—and the destiny of all.

choices.description: Choose to destroy the Heavenly Eye and liberate all bound prophets, but the Tianji Record will be destroyed alongside you.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all powers of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Completely break the chains of fate and attain true freedom
choices.risk_hint: Lose all cultivation foundations and start anew

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while, finally slowly nodding: "This path... is the one Chen Xuan was unable to complete in his time. You resemble him more than this old man anticipated." On the Tianji Record Fragment, the rune of the first path suddenly glowed, and Chen Ji felt something within him resonating with it.

text.content: However, at this moment, a sudden violent fluctuation came from the depths of the temporal rift. An aged and familiar voice pierced through the void, clearly falling into Chen Ji's ears: "Ji'er, wait. Your grandfather still has words for you." Chen Tianming—his grandfather, that man who should have been eternally trapped in the temporal rift, had actually taken the initiative to establish contact.

choices.description: Choose to devour your grandfather's remnant soul, inherit the Heavenly Eye's will, and become the new master of destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Forever lose the qualification of being human
choices.visible_reward: Obtain supreme power to rewrite fate

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's expression turned complex, carrying both relief and deep worry: "Replacing the Heavenly Way... No one has ever walked this path. You will become an existence beyond gods and demons, but the price is—you will no longer be Chen Ji." On the Tianji Record Fragment, the runes of the second path began to emit an eerie glow.

text.content: From the depths of the Spacetime Rift, Chen Tianming's voice rang out again, this time with barely concealed urgency: "Ji'er, don't! This path is the one your master walked and failed—devouring the Heavenly Way's will, you will no longer be yourself!" Chen Ji froze, for the first time hearing genuine emotion in his grandfather's voice, not merely the calculations of that remnant soul.

choices.description: Both paths are too extreme. More information is needed to decide. First, meet the grandfather and hear his true thoughts.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain More Critical Information from Grandfather
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's pursuers may arrive at any moment

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard, deep in thought: "Prudent. This old man was too hasty—the two paths indeed should not be decided rashly. But Ji'er, you must understand, no matter which path you choose, it must be completed while you remain conscious. Once the Heavenly Eye detects your intent, it will spare no effort to obliterate you."

text.content: Chen Ji looked up toward the Spacetime Rift, where the fluctuations grew increasingly violent. He knew his grandfather Chen Tianming was exhausting his final strength to maintain this connection. If he didn't respond soon, this connection could break at any moment. "Grandfather." Chen Ji spoke softly, "Your grandson has arrived."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the Tianji Record hovering before his chest. He closed his eyes and used his divine sense to probe into that Spacetime Rift. In an instant, an elderly yet gentle power enveloped him—that was Chen Tianming's aura, carrying a faint herbal fragrance and the ink scent of books, as if transporting him back to his childhood reading at his grandfather's knee. "Ji'er." Chen Tianming's voice resounded in his mind, "Grandfather has waited for this day for a very long time."

"Grandfather, why did you choose to fall into the Spacetime Rift back then?" Chen Ji asked within his divine sense. Chen Tianming was silent for a moment, then sighed: "Because this old man discovered that the Heavenly Eye is not invincible—its power comes from the Heavenly Fate values of all seers converging. If someone could sever its power source, it would fall into slumber." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open: "So you chose to self-detonate, turning your own Heavenly Fate into nothingness to weaken it?"

"Not only that." Chen Tianming's voice carried a trace of bitterness, "After this old man self-detonated, the remnant soul was trapped in the Spacetime Rift, using itself as a chain to continue sealing the core consciousness of the Heavenly Eye. For thirty years, this old man has waited every moment for someone who could inherit this old man's will and complete the final step." Chen Ji was silent for a long while, then suddenly asked: "Who is that person? Is it me, or someone else?"

text.content: Chen Tianming's remnant soul trembled slightly in the spacetime, as if hesitating how to answer. Finally, he spoke: "Initially, this old man chose Ling Yuan as the successor. He was exceptionally talented, with an almost frantic longing for the Heavenly Way. But later, this old man discovered his ambition was too great—great enough to be willing to cooperate with the Heavenly Eye—such a person, once gaining power, would be even more terrifying than the Heavenly Eye." Chen Ji's heart shook, finally understanding why Ling Yuan was so obsessed with him.

dialogue.content: "So you chose grandson?" Chen Ji asked. Chen Tianming's voice carried a touch of tenderness: "Not just because you bear the surname Chen, but because you endured fifteen years under the waste label yet never truly gave up. This endurance is not cowardice, but—" "Concealing one's brilliance and biding time." Chen Ji took over, a self-deprecating smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, "Grandfather may not know, it was precisely these fifteen years as a废物 that taught grandson how to survive in this world."

text.content: Chen Tianming fell silent for a moment, then suddenly said: "Ji'er, grandfather must tell you one thing—your sister Chen Nian is not only the Heavenly Fate Key, but also the key to breaking the shackles. Only she can sever the Heavenly Eye's power source without destroying the Tianji Record." Chen Ji raised his head sharply, a flash of determination in his eyes: "Then grandson will go save her." "But the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—" Chen Tianming hesitated. "Rest assured, grandfather." Chen Ji stood up, his gaze burning like flames, "Grandson has been arranging the world for many years—some chess pieces should now be moved."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, overlooking the countless lights of Tianqing Sect. He knew the next move would determine the fate of the entire world. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist could conceal the Tianji Record's aura, Su Qingyao within the sect could restrain Ling Yuan, and he himself—must personally step into that Forbidden Land.

choices.description: The Holy Sect Saintess's "Demonic Path Mist" is the key to entering the Forbidden Grounds. Her cooperation must be secured first.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Cover of Demonic Path Mist
choices.risk_hint: The puppet strings on Ye Qing's body have yet to be resolved

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a black transmission talisman, a token he had exchanged with Ye Qing during their last cooperation. The moment the talisman ignited, Ye Qing's cold voice came through: "Chen Ji? Contacting me this late—is something amiss?" Chen Ji said heavily: "I need your Demonic Path Mist. In three days, I will go to a place—the seals there will become fragile because of your abilities."

choices.description: The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow has tremendous influence within the sect. Her involvement in restraining Ling Yuan is most appropriate.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose More Secrets to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Gain the greatest support within the Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may fall into danger due to knowing too much

dialogue.content: Chen Ji found Su Qingyao who was in seclusion. When he laid everything bare, Su Qingyao fell silent for a full quarter of an hour. Finally, she raised her head, her eyes carrying a complex emotion: "Chen Ji, have you been using me from the very beginning?" Chen Ji shook his head: "Not using—trusting. I simply—wasn't ready to let you see the complete me yet."

choices.description: Prevent anyone from getting entangled in this crisis, infiltrate the Holy Sect's forbidden lands alone.
choices.risk_hint: Once discovered, will be left without any assistance

text.content: Chen Ji recalled all communication talismans, deciding to act alone. He knew only too well that one wrong step would mean utter destruction. But he was even more aware—he had already entangled too many people in his chess game. It was time to let them withdraw. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Are you certain? This old man can lend you power once more—but only once."

Three days later, Chen Ji stood on the wilderness beyond the Tianqing Sect. Beside him, Su Qingyao was clad in combat attire, her eyes resolute; Ye Qing lurked in the shadows, the scent of demonic path mist lingering faintly. Chen Ji raised his gaze to the horizon—dark clouds gathered, thunder rumbled distantly—that was the Heavenly Eye giving a warning. It had already sensed Chen Ji's intent. "Time is running out." Chen Ji murmured, "Let's go." The three transformed into streams of light, racing toward the direction of the Demonic Holy Sect.

However, just as they were about to leave the Tianqing Sect's territory, a sharp sword light suddenly slashed out from the Void! Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, a talisman flying from his sleeve barely blocking the strike. The newcomer stood in mid-air—it was Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect. His face twisted with sickening delight: "Chen Ji! I've waited for this moment for three full years! Today, you shall not leave alive!" Chen Ji stared expressionlessly, but in his heart he was calculating rapidly—Han Lie's arrival was too perfectly timed; someone must have leaked information. Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: "Trash!" Han Lie roared, "Do you have any idea how you, a piece of garbage from the Servants' Quarters, has made geniuses of three major Sects into laughingstocks! Today, I shall show everyone who the real废物 is!" His momentum surged暴涨, spiritual energy swirling around him like a wild tide—that was the Xuanwu Sect's secret Inheritance, the Xuanwu Battle Physique—legend has it that when fully activated, it can shake mountains.

Chen Ji gazed at this genius blinded by rage, the corner of his lips slightly raised. Three years had passed, yet Han Lie hadn't changed at all—he remained that idiot who only understood the language of fists. He spoke softly, his voice small but clearly reaching everyone's ears: "Senior Han, do you know why you always lose to me?" Han Lie froze, instinctively halting his attack.

"Because you're too impatient." Chen Ji stepped forward, each footfall striking weak points in Han Lie's momentum, "Three years ago when you hunted me, you were too impatient—I led you into the demon beast territory. Two years ago when you challenged me, you were too impatient—I schemed against you during the sparring. One year ago when you ambushed me, you were too impatient—I turned enemies against you again." He stopped before Han Lie, his gaze tranquil, "Senior Han, you've never lost due to strength—it's your brain."

text.content: Han Lie's face flushed crimson, veins bulging on his forehead. Just as he was about to erupt, Chen Ji continued: "But today, I don't wish to tangle with you." He stepped aside, clearing a path, gesturing with an inviting hand, "If Senior Han wishes to fight, I'll entertain you another day. But right now, I have something more important—saving my sister." Han Lie was stunned, clearly not expecting such words. Chen Ji glanced at him no more, leading Su Qingyao and Ye Qing to continue forward.

Han Lie stood frozen in place, the hand gripping his sword trembling slightly. He wanted to pursue, yet found himself unable to move. "Save his sister"—these words pierced his heart like a thorn. He had heard of Chen Nian's situation, the Heavenly Fate Key taken by the Holy Sect. So this trash had been enduring all along for this matter? An inexplicable emotion suddenly surged within him.

Seven days later, outside the Demonic Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji stood in a barren valley, before him a seal formation radiating cold,幽光. Beyond the seal lay Chen Nian's place of captivity. "This formation..." Ye Qing frowned, "Relying solely on my demonic mist, I can only pry open a gap, and it will only last the time of one incense stick." Chen Ji nodded: "That will be enough." He turned to Su Qingyao, "Yao'er, if anything happens to me, the Tianqing Sect will be entrusted to you." Su Qingyao bit her lip, a flash of reluctance in her eyes, yet ultimately she did not utter a single word of protest.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji is about to enter the forbidden lands, facing unknown dangers. At this moment, he needs to make final preparations.

choices.description: One incense stick's time, swift victory, take Chen Nian directly.
choices.visible_cost: May encounter encirclement by Holy Sect experts
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian in the fastest possible manner
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, margin for error is extremely low

text.content: Ye Qing formed seals with both hands, demonic mist instantly shrouding Chen Ji. His form became illusory, like a specter merging with darkness. "Go!" Ye Qing commanded quietly. A tiny crack appeared on the seal formation. Chen Ji's figure flashed,毫不犹豫地钻了进去. Within the formation, all was dark and幽暗, only distant chains' clinking sounds—pulling at Chen Ji's heartstrings.

choices.description: No rush to go deeper. First, use the Tianji Record to foresee what might happen within an incense stick's time, and prepare countermeasures.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes Heavenly Fate, and may expose one's location
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, greatly reducing risk
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is limited, cannot be used frequently

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't rush in. Instead, he sat cross-legged and pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against his Brow Center. After a moment, he opened his eyes, a flash of brilliance within: 'There are two Nascent Soul Stage guards in the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, and also one... an old monster at the Transcendent Stage.' Ye Qing's expression shifted: 'Transcendent Stage? How is that possible? How could I not know about a Holy Sect Transcendent Stage expert?' Chen Ji said solemnly: 'Because that's not a person—it's a puppet. A Transcendent Stage puppet controlled by the Heavenly Eye.'

choices.description: Set up teleportation arrays and signal formation arrays outside to prepare for emergencies.
choices.visible_cost: Requires extra time, may miss the optimal moment
choices.visible_reward: Have an escape route, maintain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The disturbance from setting up formations may attract Holy Sect detection

text.content: Chen Ji took out dozens of precious formation materials from his storage bag and began inscribing formation runes around the valley. Ye Qing watched in amazement: 'When did you learn to set up formations?' Chen Ji didn't look up: 'Fifteen years as a Servant Disciple, one must learn some skills to get by.' Su Qingyao watched him silently, a flicker of heartache in her eyes. How many secrets does this man still hide?

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Forbidden Grounds, the surrounding aura suddenly turned icy and biting. Demonic Path mist swirled around him, completely concealing his presence. He moved along the direction of the chain sounds, every step cautious, avoiding the formations and guards along the way. After walking for who knows how long, he finally saw that figure suspended in mid-air by chains—a young girl in white robes, whose face bore a seven-point resemblance to his own. It was his long-lost sister, Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: 'Niannian!' Chen Ji could no longer contain himself, his figure bursting forth toward Chen Nian. However, the instant he was about to reach her, a terrifying presence descended! The Transcendent Stage puppet he had foreseen appeared before him, radiating pressure that transcended the Nascent Soul Stage. Most terrifying of all—that face was identical to Chen Ji's! The puppet spoke, its voice ice-cold: 'Chen Ji, you've finally come. The Heavenly Eye has been waiting for you for a long time.'

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly steadied his mind, his gaze locked死死on that face identical to his own. 'Who are you?' The puppet sneered: 'Who am I? You should be asking—who do you think you are?' Before the words finished, countless images flooded into Chen Ji's mind like a tide: that was the day Chen Nian was taken away, the moment Grandfather Chen Tianming fell into the spacetime rift, the night the Heavenly Eye first selected him—all memories intertwining to reveal a truth he had never imagined.

Originally, the reason he obtained the Tianji Record was not due to talent or fortune—it was because he was a chess piece selected by the Heavenly Eye. That Transcendent Stage puppet was created by the Heavenly Eye using a fragment of his divided soul. The puppet had only one task: at the final moment, replace him to become the new prophet, continuing to collect Heavenly Fate for the Heavenly Eye. 'Now you understand?' The puppet coldly smiled, 'You were never someone destined to break free—you're only a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.'

Chen Ji stood in place, silent for a long while. The puppet thought he had succumbed to despair, was about to step forward and harvest his life, when suddenly Chen Ji laughed. That laughter was not loud, yet it sounded especially clear in this silent Forbidden Grounds. 'Did you think I didn't know all this?' Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes blazing with an all-seeing light, 'Did you think that over these fifteen years, I was passively accepting fate's arrangements? Mr. Puppet, you're too naive.'

Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand, and an unprecedented rune appeared in his palm—that was the forbidden technique usable only after the complete unsealing of the Tianji Record. 'When Chen Xuan Master imparted the Tianji Record to my grandfather, he left behind a contingency. He knew that someday, the Heavenly Eye would try to use a puppet to replace the true inheritor.' Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold, 'So he added a trace of—Soul-Severing Power into this rune.'

The rune suddenly blazed, emitting light that purified everything! The puppet's expression greatly changed, wanting to retreat but it was already too late. That light pierced through his body, completely incinerating the divided soul belonging to the Heavenly Eye within him. The puppet's form began to dissipate, finally turning into scattered light and vanishing. From the depths of the Forbidden Grounds came an angry roar—the Heavenly Eye's main body roaring in fury. It knew that the chess game it had meticulously arranged for fifteen years had been completely overturned by this 'waste.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji cut the chains binding Chen Nian, pulling his unconscious sister into his arms. Her body was ice-cold, her breathing weak—she had clearly been tormented here for far too long. Chen Ji's heart bled, yet his face remained calm. 'Niannian, Big Brother is late.' He said softly, 'But from now on, Big Brother will never let anyone hurt you again.' Just then, Ye Qing's urgent voice came from the exit of the Forbidden Grounds: 'Chen Ji! Get out quickly! The Holy Sect's army has surrounded this place!'

text.content: Chen Ji lifted Chen Nian and executed the instantaneous movement technique recorded in the Tianji Record, appearing at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds in the blink of an eye. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist was already nearly unable to hold on, and Su Qingyao was locked in battle with two Nascent Soul Stage experts. Chen Ji didn't waste words, his left arm holding Chen Nian while his right hand struck out repeatedly, dozens of talismans flying out simultaneously, forcing back those two Nascent Soul experts. 'Go!' he shouted, bringing the three people as they broke through the Holy Sect's encirclement and vanished into the vast night.

Three days later, in a hidden valley of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Nian finally woke up, and the first thing she saw was Chen Ji sitting guard beside the bed. 'Brother... Big Brother?' Her voice was hoarse, her eyes full of disbelief, 'How... how can you be here? Where is this...' Chen Ji held her hand, his voice gentle: 'This is the Tianqing Sect. Niannian, you're safe.' Chen Nian's tears burst forth, and she tightly embraced Chen Ji, crying loudly. Chen Ji didn't speak, only gently patting her back, yet his gaze became incomparably resolute.

Night had deepened, and Chen Nian had fallen back into a deep sleep under Chen Ji's soothing. Chen Ji walked out of the room and looked up at the starry sky. The Tianji Record Fragment automatically appeared before him, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rose from within, his expression complex: 'You did it. But Chen Ji, you must understand—the Heavenly Eye will not let this rest. It already knows you are its greatest threat, and next, it will动用all its strength to erase you.' Chen Ji nodded: 'I know.' Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'How much time do you have left?' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, gazing at the faintly visible spacetime rift in the distance: 'Not much. But it's enough.'

Just then, an intense fluctuation suddenly came from the depths of the spacetime rift. Chen Tianming's voice rang out again, this time carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Ji'er, the time is near. I sense the Heavenly Eye is awakening, and it has mobilized all dormant powers to deal with you. You must make the final choice before it fully awakens—either break the shackles; or replace Heaven.' Chen Ji tightly clenched his fist, not speaking. Chen Tianming's voice continued: 'Whichever path you choose, Grandfather will support you. But there is one thing I must tell you—Chen Nian is not only the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, she is also...' The voice cut off abruptly, as if forcibly severed by some force.

Chen Ji raised his head sharply, a flash of alarm in his eyes. Grandfather's words had been interrupted, but that unfinished secret was like a thorn lodged in his heart. Chen Nian was not only the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, what else was she? She was the key to breaking the shackles—could there still be a secret he didn't know? The Tianji Record Fragment trembled intensely, and Mo Xiansheng's voice rose: 'Ji'er, this old man just sensed a powerful force monitoring us. The Heavenly Eye... it has set its sights on Chen Nian.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze becoming前所未有的锐利: 'It wants her?' Mo Xiansheng said solemnly: 'Not just wants—it needs her. Without her, the Heavenly Eye cannot complete its final transformation.'

Chen Ji turned and walked back into the room, looking at his sleeping sister. Her face was peaceful, as if unaware of how many storms were waiting for her outside. Chen Ji silently vowed in his heart: whatever the cost, he would protect her. Even if he had to make an enemy of all of Heaven, he would not hesitate. Outside the window, the night was as ink, the starlight dim. On the distant horizon, a purple-black light was slowly gathering—that was the sign of the Heavenly Eye's awakening, and also the trumpet of the final battle. Chen Ji walked out of the room and stood atop the valley's summit, overlooking this land about to be swept by the storm. The corners of his mouth slightly rose, revealing a faint smile—that was the composure of a chess player before placing a piece, and also the confidence of a waste person on the verge of a counterattack. 'Come then.' he said softly, 'Let me see exactly how strong this Heaven is.'
